pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [1187, 712, 1237, 834] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.
